messages:
marta (sec-lead): quick heads-up: contracted RedTeamCo for a focused pen-test on 2026-04-02 09:00 PDT. Scope: read-only evidence pulls, KMS decrypt for artifacts, full audit trail. Planning 30m dry-run 2026-04-01 10:00. @pranav @tess please confirm RBAC + KMS plan. cc @jon for telemetry.

pranav (infra): propose ephemeral in-account role redteam/assessor with trust limited to vendor principals, max session 1h. Permissions: s3:GetObject/ListBucket on redwood-pt-evidence, logs:FilterLogEvents/GetLogEvents on pt log groups, kms:Decrypt on one key ARN. Deny Put/Delete.

Tess (eng-sre): agree. will add explicit Deny for prefixes we don't want read (arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/models/* and /generated/*). Also enable S3 Server Access Logging for object reads.

marta (sec-lead): legal constraint: no key material or plaintext handing. KMS must use Grants scoped to role and require encryptionContext filter. Decrypt logs must be retained 90+ days. @pranav can you do grants lifecycle?

pranav (infra): yes. will create a one-off KMS Grant scoped to the assessor role with EncryptionContext {"evidence-origin":"redteamco"}. I'll record grant ID and provide revocation steps. Will test in staging. ETA staging prep 2026-03-30 EOD.

jon (platform): enable CloudTrail data events for S3 reads on the evidence bucket and ship to locked audit bucket with MFA-delete. Also set CloudWatch Logs retention 365d for the pt log groups. This gives immutable read evidence for retest.

Tess (eng-sre): sample policy snippet I will use for the role (trimmed):

```json
{"Statement":[
  {"Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence","arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/*"]},
  {"Action":["logs:GetLogEvents","logs:FilterLogEvents"],"Resource":["arn:aws:logs:us-west-2:123456789012:log-group:/redwood/pt/*"]},
  {"Action":["kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789"]}
]}
```

marta (sec-lead): looks good. include explicit resource exclude for /models/* and /generated/* and document encryptionContext requirement in runbook.

pranav (infra): I'll post CloudFormation snippet for role + grant to this thread when ready. Will include automated revocation job that runs after the engagement.

Tess (eng-sre): running a pre-dry-run checklist tomorrow; will validate assume-role flow, S3 read logs, CloudTrail object events, and KMS decrypt audit entries.

marta (sec-lead): action items: pranav create role+grant in staging (due 3/30), tess pre-dry-run checklist (due 3/31), jon enable CloudTrail data events & logging (due 3/31), marta confirm vendor principal ARNs and upload whitelist (today).

jon (platform): invite sent for dry-run 2026-04-01 10:00 PDT. audit-bot attach notes. :calendar: 

audit-bot: automated note - CloudTrail data events will be enabled for arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence and archived for 395 days.

Tess (eng-sre): one more compatibility check: some services write to evidence bucket under /ephemeral-uploads/. I'll add that prefix to the deny list.

marta (sec-lead): good. also planning retest 1h slot week of 2026-04-15 after remediation. I'll open retest request once report is in. Leaving thread open for artifacts. :wave:
